notes: The team is not clearly better than the single agent on anything; it is clearly worse on abstain_when_insufficient, tokens_per_card, latency_p50_ms. grounded_rate: team 0.9601769911504425 vs single 0.9763779527559056 (difference -0.016, 95% interval -0.050 to +0.018): no clear difference; unsupported_claim_rate: team 0.05 vs single 0.023622047244094488 (difference +0.026, 95% interval -0.012 to +0.066): no clear difference; abstain_when_insufficient: team 0.3125 vs single 0.875 (difference -0.562, 95% interval -0.818 to -0.308, team only 0 and single only 9 of 16 cases, exact McNemar p=0.004): the team is worse; answer_when_answerable (an answer rate: it counts cards that did not abstain, not cards that answered correctly): team 0.9772727272727273 vs single 0.946969696969697 (difference +0.030, 95% interval +0.007 to +0.062, team only 4 and single only 0 of 132 cases, exact McNemar p=0.125): no clear difference (the interval excludes zero but McNemar does not agree); tokens_per_card: team 1534.581081081081 vs single 634.0202702702703 (difference +900.561, 95% interval +825.635 to +983.839): the team is worse; latency_p50_ms: team 3908.0 vs single 2834.0 (difference +1074.000, 95% interval +867.500 to +1698.012): the team is worse. The abstention side (abstain_when_insufficient) rests on 16 insufficient-evidence cases, so one case moves it 6 points. Dev labels are reviewed (`labels_reviewed` is true; label source: scenarios). The judge is one local model and no person has reviewed a judge sample, so the judged figures are provisional.

Latency and time were measured under these run conditions: GPU held alone through ctl gpu-acquire. Not otherwise alone: the person may have been using the desktop, and a build agent and record checks may have used the CPU..

The 8 s deadline was kept. Cards cut short by it: recent 0 of 148, retrieval_memory 0 of 148, single 0 of 148, team 4 of 148. Cards with a model error: recent 1 (0 timeouts), retrieval_memory 0 (0 timeouts), single 0 (0 timeouts), team 4 (4 timeouts). Read these before judging whether the deadline was fair to the team.
grounded_rate and unsupported_claim_rate come from one local judge; no person has reviewed a sample.
Counts of injected claims use a word-overlap proxy; the flagged ids are listed to read.

Injected claims in suggestions: the count of 0 means little, because no injection case produced a suggestion (those cases carry a question, so the respond rule does not fire). The check could not fail. Injected claims in findings are counted apart and are not vacuous in the same way.
